download_emu_edit_dataset: download the Emu-Edit dataset from HuggingFace and save prompts and images to a local directory
load_emu_edit_prompts: load all Emu-Edit prompts from the downloaded JSONL file into a lookup dictionary keyed by lookup_key
get_emu_edit_prompt_by_id: get a single Emu-Edit prompt by its lookup_key from the downloaded dataset directory
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it processes test and validation splits from HuggingFace
summarize_emu_edit_module: summarize the Emu-Edit module that downloads image editing prompts and saves them as JSONL with images
